value.signature: fn fmt (& self , formatter : & mut fmt :: Formatter < '_ >) -> fmt :: Result

exception.justification: Justified: This formatter reports only lifecycle state and capability presence, suppressing the monotonic origin and private address.

review.body: { formatter . debug_struct ("Prepared") . field ("controller" , & self . controller . state ()) . field ("clock" , & "[monotonic origin]") . field ("stop" , & self . stop . is_some ()) . field ("address" , & self . address . is_some ()) . finish () }
review.item_premise: The formatter emits public state and capability presence only; its Debug output cannot borrow or print the protected notification address.
